# Stellar browser dependency

`stellar-sdk.min.js` is copied unmodified from `@stellar/stellar-sdk@16.4.1/dist/stellar-sdk.min.js`, installed through the root lockfile. Apache-2.0 license: `STELLAR-SDK-LICENSE`; the bundle also retains its embedded third-party license notices.

When upgrading the root dependency, copy the browser bundle and license again, then rerun the browser Testnet verification. GitHub Pages serves this pinned local file; no CDN is required.
